title: andrachne ovalis
intro: Andrachne ovalis, commonly known as Round-leaved Andrachne, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Andrachne ovalis include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are present in its leaves and roots.
